name: 朱砂囊
subject: A stout oxblood-red woven cinnabar pouch with a narrow gathered mouth, thick dark red drawstring knot, one small cream cloth patch with a simple red square pigment mark. A little folded fabric flap exposes a cluster of three vermilion pigment grains at its mouth. Dusty practical cloth, no jewel or bottle. Broad bag silhouette.

name: 龙王逆鳞
subject: A single thick sea-dragon reverse scale: broad dark teal armor plate with two stepped pointed shoulders, sharply narrowed lower point, raised central ridge and a chipped pale edge. Restrained turquoise patina and a tiny bronze suspension clamp at top. Clearly a rough organic dragon scale, not a shield or gem pendant.

name: 龙珠
subject: A warm ivory dragon pearl held in an old bronze three-prong claw cage with one thick short suspension loop. Pearl is a slightly asymmetric stepped orb, three broad cream/gold shading clusters and one dark amber spiral inclusion. Small weathered cage, no ornate frame, no glow. Original dragon treasure, not an ender pearl recolor.

name: 狐尾坠
subject: A wearable curled fox-tail charm hanging from a small dark bronze ring and red cord knot. Broad bushy russet tail, thick cream-white tip forming a big jagged stepped tuft, one dark brown underside strip. Clear taper into the attachment and a large soft-looking furry silhouette built entirely from hard square pixel clusters; not a feather.

name: 金印
subject: An ancient solid gold official seal shown in three-quarter view: substantial square stamp body with a thick carved arch-shaped loop handle on top, two chunky vermilion cord loops tied through it. Worn muted gold, dark bronze underside, one square nick in corner. Clearly a compact heavy stamp, not a pedestal or trophy, no letters.

name: 御玺佩
subject: A small imperial jade seal pendant in three-quarter view: thick dark green square seal body, pale jade stepped coiled-dragon knob on top, a narrow bronze band around lower rim, short vermilion hanging cord behind. Compact carved stone stamp with clearly readable body thickness and knob; no floating green gem, no ornate illustration, no text.

name: 玉璧
subject: An ancient pale green jade bi disc: broad thick annular jade stone with a large clean central hole, asymmetric chipped outer rim, two broad stepped cloud relief grooves and a small dark brown hanging cord through top rim. Three jade shades, muted cream mineral patch; clearly substantial stone ring, not a record, coin or donut food.

name: 玉冠
subject: An ancient Chinese jade ceremonial headpiece, not a European tiara: three upright rectangular green jade plates of graduated heights seated in a low dull bronze brow rail, small bronze side pin, two short dark green fabric ties. Pale jade square highlights and deep forest green edges; compact readable wearable headpiece.

name: 功牌
subject: An old military merit badge hanging from a thick oxblood cord loop: a stout dark wooden rectangular tally inset with a worn bronze plate, three deep horizontal tally notches cut into its right edge, two large bronze rivets. One small bronze star-like angular mark, no written characters or letters. Clearly a practical service medal, not a coin.

name: 麒麟角坠
subject: One qilin horn pendant: a thick curved warm ivory horn with broad ridged dark amber root, one short angular side spur near its base and a strong upward-hooked tip. Dark bronze collar around root with tiny red cord loop. The horn is large and chunky, recognizable bone material; no deer antler branches or tooth shape.

name: 海螺
subject: A large ancient sea conch shell accessory, three-quarter diagonal view: thick ivory spiral whorls at upper left, wide chipped flared mouth exposing muted coral interior at lower right, three blunt angular ridges and short tapered end. Strong empty dark mouth opening, readable shell silhouette, not a copy of vanilla nautilus shell.

name: 避水珠
subject: A water-repelling pearl charm: large pale aquamarine stepped pearl cradled by three thick dark bronze prongs shaped like simple bent hooks, a narrow bronze hanging loop and one short deep-blue cord. The pearl has three broad flat color clusters, a tiny square pale highlight and a dark wave-shaped inclusion; no shine halo, not a potion or glass bottle.

name: 锦囊
subject: An emerald-green silk travel pouch with broad folded rectangular cloth body, gathered top tied with a thick oxblood-red silk band, two short red tassel ends and one cream geometric stitched patch. Three large hard-edged silk folds suggest woven material. Practical Chinese silk accessory, distinct from a blue drawstring sack, no jewel or brocade filigree.

name: 天羽
subject: A broad asymmetric white-and-ice-blue celestial feather accessory: bent dark slate quill, long stepped outer vane with two clear gaps near lower edge, short wrapped silver cap at base and small navy suspension cord. Thick coarse pixel clusters, few big pale shade regions. Original wind-swept silhouette, not a recolor or tracing of Minecraft feather.

name: 金乌翎
subject: A three-pronged golden-crow plume accessory: thick dark charcoal quill with one broad sharply hooked orange-gold vane and two shorter jagged side vanes, dull copper binding at base, tiny dark red thread. Obsidian black central stripe and three flat amber shades, unmistakable heavy magical bird plume, no flame glow or realistic fire.

name: 虎头令
subject: An ancient Chinese tiger-head authority token: thick dull bronze plaque shaped as a broad angular tiger face with two square ears, slanted hollow dark eye slots, wide stepped muzzle and two pale metal fangs. Short dark leather suspension loop and tiny red binding. Restrained green patina, readable metal object rather than actual animal head, no text.

name: 战鼓坠
subject: A small wearable war drum in three-quarter view: squat thick red-lacquered wooden barrel, taut cream hide drumhead facing diagonally up, dark brown rope zigzags around sides, four chunky bronze rim studs and a short dark leather hanging loop. Big readable drumhead and body thickness, worn practical material; not a red cylinder or a toy.
